core_categories: Durable Medical Equipment (DME); Diabetes Management Products; Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs); Insulin Pumps; Blood Glucose Testing Supplies
specialty_focus: Advanced Diabetes Supply is a national specialty distributor of durable medical equipment (DME) focused on direct-to-home delivery of diabetes management products. It specializes in continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), insulin pumps, and testing supplies, and provides insurance verification and automated supply fulfillment for patients across the United States.
key_brands: Dexcom, Abbott, Omnipod, Tandem, Medtronic, Bayer, Contour Next, others
